project.name: v1-decisions-only
project.description: The 62066bc shape, isolated: a document whose entire value is decisions, with no services at all.

decisions.decision: Bundle the CLI in dist/ and publish templates alongside it.

alternatives.name: Ship only source files
alternatives.whyNot: Would require a build step after install and make the package harder to use.

decisions.decision: Force React 19 via Vite aliases to deduplicate with the root project
decisions.rationale: Viewer nested in src/viewer/ caused React 18 vs 19 duplicate, breaking hooks.

alternatives.name: Pin viewer to React 18 independently
alternatives.whyNot: Would still cause duplicate React instances since root has React 19
